messages:
Maria (Support): Heads up — HospNet (tenant: hospnet-01) opened an urgent support ticket (TKT-9876). They report missing audit logs for API calls that contain PHI between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-03, and some calls returned 403 KMS_DECRYPT errors. They're on Redwood Dedicated with customer-managed KMS. Asking for: exported audit logs for the window, confirmation of BAA-compliant retention, and whether any KMS/HSM key rotation or access events happened. Escalating to Security + SRE. @Alex (Security) @Sam (SRE) :flag-us:

Alex (Security): Thanks Maria. Can you paste an example request_id and the raw error lines? Also need customer KMS key ARN and whether they reported any changes on their side (IAM changes / key rotation). We'll need to correlate CloudTrail + KMS logs.

Maria (Support): Provided below from their packet capture / app logs — redacted keys:
```
Error: 403 KMS_DECRYPT
request_id=8f3b1c9d
api_path=/v1/generate
tenant=hospnet-01
user=hospnet:svc-analytics
kms_key_arn=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345
stack: kms:Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
```
They also mentioned intermittently elevated latency for generate calls around 2025-11-02 03:20-03:35 UTC.

Sam (SRE): Got it. Two quick asks: 1) Is the tenant on our Dedicated control plane or Private VPC? (Dedicated confirmed by Maria, but want to confirm if their KMS is reachable from our control plane). 2) I'll export the node-level audit logs. Maria, can you run the admin export command or I can run it if you want? Example CLI to pull audit logs:
```
redwood logs export --tenant hospnet-01 --from 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z --to 2025-11-03T23:59:59Z --type audit --output s3://redwood-exports/hospnet/audit-202511 --include-raw-headers
```
Or via Console: Console -> Compliance -> Audit logs -> Export -> choose date range -> S3 destination.

Maria (Support): I'm running the export now (starting). Also created an incident record: IncidentsBot: INC-202511-42 created (severity P2) and attached the customer ticket. Will upload export link when done.

IncidentsBot: Incident INC-202511-42 assigned to oncall_sre (Sam). Slack thread linked.

Alex (Security): Please confirm whether HospNet uses customer-managed KMS (they do) and whether they use an external HSM integration. If it's AWS KMS, I'll pull CloudTrail and KMS key usage for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345 for the time window. Also need evidence for BAA retention policy — we keep immutable audit logs for X days (policy doc). Maria, attach the signed healthcare addendum or indicate if they are requesting to sign one.

Maria (Support): Customer says they already have a signed BAA but are asking for a written attestation showing logs were retained for the window. I'll attach the signed addendum copy to the ticket and share here.

Sam (SRE): Quick findings from initial node log scan (I pulled partial export): I see multiple KMS Decrypt failures originating from redwood-worker-04 in us-west-2 with the same request_ids around 2025-11-02T03:21:12Z. Stack indicates AccessDenied from AWS KMS. No evidence of our control plane rejecting the request due to RBAC. Possible causes: 1) Customer changed key policy or disabled the key; 2) temporary cross-account permissions issue; 3) transient AWS KMS outage in region. I'm going to query CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt and look for ErrorCode entries.

Kevin (ProdEng): If it's a key policy change on the customer side, the right remediation is to: have customer re-grant decrypt permissions to the IAM role we use (arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/redwood-kms-access) or re-enable key. We should also check whether our key rotation job ran and attempted a re-encrypt. If the key was rotated (customer or KMS automatic rotation), that shouldn't break decrypts if policies stay the same.

Alex (Security): If customer requests a formal attestation for BAA retention, we can provide: 1) export of audit logs for requested window (delivered via signed S3 presigned URL), 2) signed statement referencing our retention policy section (Compliance -> Data Retention), and 3) CloudTrail/KMS usage evidence showing successful decrypts before/after the window. I'll prepare a short attestation doc once we have the exported logs.

Maria (Support): Export completed. Upload: s3://redwood-exports/hospnet/audit-202511/audit-2025-11-01_11-00-partial.json (presigned link attached in ticket). Customer confirmed they didn't rotate keys during that window but did report manual IAM changes later on 2025-11-04. They insist the critical requests were between 11/01-11/03.

Sam (SRE): I checked CloudTrail for the KMS key ARN — found the following events (summarized): kms:Decrypt failure entries at 2025-11-02T03:21:12Z with ErrorCode=AccessDenied; successful Decrypts before and after the window. Also no scheduled HSM/network maintenance from our side in that window. Looks like the key policy rejected access for our decrypt call at that timestamp. I'll attach the CloudTrail snippet to the incident.

Alex (Security): Ok — sounds like customer-side key policy change or temporary IAM permission issue. For the BAA attestation, we'll supply the audit export + CloudTrail snippet + a statement that no Redwood-managed HSM maintenance or key rotation occurred in that window. Maria, please confirm you have the signed BAA and we'll include a copy in the attestation bundle.

Maria (Support): Confirmed. Adding signed BAA PDF to the incident. Customer requested a written timeline and next steps to prevent recurrence: recommend preflight checks to ensure KMS key policy includes our role, monitor kms:Decrypt error rates as an alert, and add a runbook for immediate mitigation (switch to Redwood-managed KMS fallback only with customer agreement).

Kevin (ProdEng): Action items assigned: 1) Sam to attach CloudTrail/KMS evidence to INC-202511-42 (ETA 2h). 2) Alex to draft BAA attestation + retention confirmation (ETA EOD). 3) Maria to deliver exports and runbook to customer and confirm acceptance. I'll prepare a short playbook for customers on Dedicated + customer-managed KMS onboarding.

Maria (Support): Noted. Customer replied: "We need the exported logs and the attestation by EOD tomorrow — this is compliance-critical." I will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:

Sam (SRE): Attached CloudTrail snippet to the incident. No sign of internal HSM events. Will keep monitoring KMS error rates and add a temporary alert rule for tenant hospnet-01.

Alex (Security): Drafted attestation and retention statement (internal draft). Will post final signed version after legal review. Thanks team.

Maria (Support): Closing loop for now — will update once legal signs attestation and customer confirms. Thanks everyone. :pray:
